beats.action: Vesper asks the counterfactual. Daon lays out both branches plainly: safety staff pulling him away, and the guest's hand possibly stopping or possibly hitting his glass shade.
Daon shrugs off her own lateness as the time it took to weigh those outcomes. She frames it as her own delay.
Realization lands on Vesper. The morning's single check now reads as a wager, and his future slips will be charged to Daon's record, not to his flame.
His light betrays him, cooling to blue and only slowly returning to orange. He bows formally, apologizes and announces a proposal. Daon answers warily.
Vesper presents his solution: make himself less welcoming, with no selfies, no waving and no courtesies, and become a boring costume character.
Daon goes still, looking up at him with her hand frozen on the radio. Her disbelief erupts. His hesitant promise to try only makes her more nervous. This is the comic peak.
Despite her doubts, Daon opens the morning memo on her phone and writes the plan in as new unchecked lines beneath the single existing check.
Daon claims the plan as her own for her evaluation score, and Vesper seals it as a joint operation. The alliance is renewed, with her stake stated openly.

facts.statement: Vesper raises a hypothetical: what if Daon had made the call during those three beats.

Daon answers that safety staff would have come, pulled Vesper back and separated him from the guest. She adds that in the meantime the guest's hand might have stopped, or might have struck his glass shade.
Daon shrugs and says she was late because she spent those three seconds making that calculation.

Only now does Vesper understand what the single check drawn that morning put at stake. If he flares his light wrongly once or leaves the route once, the cost piles up not on his flame but as a line in the tablet, under Daon's name.
Vesper's light cools to blue and returns to orange only after a long while. He then bows formally.
Vesper apologizes and says he has a proposal. Daon asks what it is.

Vesper reasons that people approach him because he is too welcoming, so he will become less welcoming. He will not accept selfies, will not wave and will not make courteous gestures. He calls this a boring costume character.
Daon looks up at him for a long time. Her hand, which had been fiddling with the radio, stops.
Daon asks in disbelief whether Vesper, of all people, will skip greetings and refuse selfies. He answers that he will try. She says she is already anxious.
Even so, Daon takes out her phone and opens the same memo from the morning. New unchecked lines appear below the single existing check. They are given verbatim in text-14.
Daon says she is fine as long as her evaluation score is protected, so this is her operation too. Vesper agrees that it is a joint operation.

brief.style: Full-color Korean romance-fantasy comedy webtoon, clean expressive linework, soft cel shading, subdued warm night shade behind a maintenance tent among tarps, lamp flame as key light.

moments.action: Among tarp covers behind the tent, towering lamp-headed Vesper poses his question; small Daon in her navy staff jacket looks up and answers plainly.
Daon gives a light shrug, owning the delay as her own, while Vesper stands still before her.
Vesper stands motionless as understanding sinks in, his gas-lamp flame cooled to a pale blue; Daon stands beside him.
His flame warm orange again, Vesper bows formally from the waist toward Daon, who eyes him warily.
Vesper stands upright and presents his plan to Daon with earnest, dignified gravity.
Daon gazes far up at Vesper, her hand frozen on her radio, face full of comic disbelief; Vesper answers with small hesitation.
Daon holds up her phone; the memo shows one checked unlettered line on top and the new unchecked lines beneath, large and legible.
Phone in hand, Daon grins and claims the plan as her own; Vesper answers her with dignified warmth.

identity.evidence: Vesper keeps the cracked brass lamp head, dark patterned tailcoat and white gloves; Daon keeps the navy staff jacket, grey tee, half-up hair, walkie-talkie and phone.

setting.evidence: Same post-parade maintenance area behind the tent with tarps, costume racks and flight cases as the previous scene.

actionTransition.evidence: The previous scene ended with Daon repeating 'one line' about the work log; Vesper now asks what would have happened had she called it in.

units.text: 천막 밖에서 목소리가 들렸다.
"두 분, 거기서 무슨 밀담해요? 나만 빼고?"
칸드라의 촛불이 천막 틈으로 반쯤 들어왔다. 그녀는 다온의 휴대폰 화면을 보더니 웃음을 터뜨렸다.
"재미없는 인형탈? 이 사람이요? 츄러스 가게 앞을 그냥 지나가겠다는 소리랑 똑같네."
"촛불님, 쉿! 이거 기밀이에요."
"레이디."
"알았어요, 알았어. 응원할게요."
칸드라는 웃으며 물러났다. 돌아서는 순간, 촛농 한 방울이 천막 자락에 떨어졌다. 베스퍼는 그것을 보았다. 그리고 묻지 않았다. 대신 자기 불빛을 한 칸 낮췄다.
다온이 메모장을 닫았다.
"내일 8시 20분이에요. 첫 실전이요. 제가 인이어로 계속 말할게요."
"분부를 기다리겠소."
그녀가 통로 쪽으로 사라졌다. 정비 구역에 다시 고요가 내려앉았다. 베스퍼는 일부러 낮춘 불빛을 그대로 붙들고 서 있었다. 불빛은 작게, 아주 작게 떨렸다. 발치에는 소화기와 뚜껑도 따지 않은 이온음료가 나란히 서 있었다.
재미없는 것이 되는 법을, 그는 수백 번의 겨울 동안 한 번도 배운 적이 없었다.

plan.intent: A light comic interruption turns into a quiet, heavy close. Kandra's teasing punctures the secret pact Daon and Vesper just made, and her laugh at the boring-costume plan says what Daon already feared: this gentleman cannot be dull. The comedy should read easily: Kandra's head poking through the tent, Daon's shush over a classified memo, a one-word formal address, and Kandra giving in. Then one small physical detail changes the temperature. As Kandra turns away, a single drop of wax falls. Vesper sees it and follows his habit: he does not ask, and he lowers his own light one notch. The reader should register the drop and his silent response without being told what either means. Daon's practical scheduling for tomorrow's first real test pulls the scene back to work. After she leaves, the quiet takes over. Vesper holds his deliberately lowered light, it trembles slightly, and the unopened drink stands beside the extinguisher at his feet. The final caption lands the scene's irony. A being who has never learned in hundreds of winters how to be boring has just promised to try, and he is already dimming himself for someone else.
plan.staging:
Setting: this continues directly from the previous scene in the same post-parade maintenance area at night, among tarp covers beside a tent. Vesper (c1) and Daon (c3) are on one side of the tent canvas. Kandra (c2) is on the other side, outside the tent, so her first line (text-2) comes from beyond the canvas; its balloon tail points toward the tent or the gap. There is no signage, logos, labels or festival titles.

Present: Vesper and Daon throughout, and Kandra only from ch-3-p-104 to ch-3-p-110. Uwoo Taerim (c4), the senior and extras are absent.

Kandra's entry: her candle head comes halfway in through a gap in the tent. Only half of it enters; the source does not say her body comes through. From there she can see Daon's phone screen, which still shows the memo from the previous scene. Its contents are not in this excerpt, so do not letter it; show it as an unlettered or illegible list. She bursts out laughing before text-3.

Speakers: text-2, text-3 and text-6 belong to Kandra, in white balloons pointing to her candle head. text-4 and text-9 belong to Daon. text-5 and text-10 belong to Vesper; he has no mouth, so his balloon tails point to his glass lamp head. text-1, text-7, text-8, text-11 and text-12 are ordinary caption boxes.

Wax drop: as Kandra turns to withdraw, smiling, a single drop of wax falls onto the tent flap. Vesper sees it, and then his own light is lowered one notch. The source gives a drop in brightness only, not a color change. Do not add any reaction from Daon to the drop; the source does not say she notices it.

Daon closes the memo on her phone before text-9. She then leaves toward the passageway, and Vesper remains alone.

Closing image elements (ch-3-p-114): Vesper stands with his light kept low, and the flame trembles very slightly. At his feet stand a fire extinguisher and an ion drink bottle, side by side, with the cap still sealed. Both objects must be clearly present in the closing moment. The drink bottle carries no readable label text.

Scale: Vesper is about 2 m tall; Daon is in the low 160s cm; Kandra is about 175 cm.

Continuity: Vesper wears the dark high-collared tailcoat and white gloves, with the crack on the upper left of his glass shade and the earpiece fastened by a plain cable tie to the brass ring beside the shade. Kandra has her ivory pillar-candle head with hardened wax drips and a dark Victorian gown. Daon wears the navy staff jacket, has her radio, wears her hair half-up and has the mole at the end of her right eyebrow.

RADIO BANDS: the in-ear earpiece is only mentioned in text-9 as tomorrow's plan. No earpiece or radio transmission happens in this scene, so draw no transmission bands.

Lettering: copy every text exactly, with no added quotation marks, speaker names, labels or other words. Panel count, sizes, cameras and layout are the artist's choice.
uncertainties: The source does not tag the speaker of ch-3-p-108, a single formal address word. It is assigned to Vesper (c1) here as a courteous hush directed at Kandra, because it appears as its own paragraph between Daon's shush and Kandra's concession. It could instead be Kandra correcting Daon's honorific for her. Treat this attribution as an editorial reading, not a stated fact.

The meaning of the wax drop in ch-3-p-110 is not stated. Kandra's character profile links running wax to sadness, but the source itself only says a drop fell. Do not show tears, a sad face or any other reaction as fact.
Why Vesper lowers his light in ch-3-p-110 is not stated. It is consistent with his established habit, but the source gives only the action.
The source says only that Vesper's light is lowered and then trembles. No color is stated for this scene, so do not assign a flame color.

The exact spatial layout is not given: whether Vesper and Daon are inside the tent or behind it, and where the gap is. It is known only that Kandra is outside and her candle comes halfway through a gap.
The memo on the phone screen belongs to the previous scene. Its wording is not in this excerpt, so it stays unlettered here.
It is not stated how long Kandra laughs, whether Vesper reacts to her mockery, or what Daon's expression is during the shush. Beyond the given lines, do not invent reactions.
Who the unopened ion drink is for, and why it was never opened, is not stated. Present it as an object only.
The churros comparison in text-3 alludes to Vesper's fondness for watching churros sugar sparkle, but the source does not spell this out. Do not add a visual flashback.

beats.action: The private moment is interrupted. A teasing voice from beyond the tent canvas accuses the pair of plotting without her.
Kandra's candle head pushes halfway through the tent gap. She catches sight of Daon's phone screen and bursts out laughing, then dismisses the boring-costume idea with her churros comparison.
Daon hushes her over the classified memo, a one-word formal address follows, and Kandra concedes cheerfully, promising her support.
Kandra withdraws smiling. As she turns, one drop of wax falls onto the tent flap. Vesper sees it, says nothing and lowers his own light one notch. This is the tonal turn of the scene.
Daon closes the memo and returns to work mode, setting tomorrow's 8:20 first real test and promising constant in-ear guidance. Vesper accepts it as her command.
Daon leaves down the passageway and quiet returns. Vesper stays alone, keeping his light held low, and it trembles faintly. The extinguisher and the unopened drink stand side by side at his feet.
The closing narration reframes the plan. In hundreds of winters he has never learned to be boring.

facts.statement: A voice comes from outside the tent. Kandra asks what secret talk the two of them are having without her.
Kandra's candle comes halfway in through a gap in the tent. She sees the screen of Daon's phone and bursts out laughing.
Kandra mocks the idea that this person, meaning Vesper, could be a boring costume character. She compares it to someone claiming they will simply walk past a churros shop.
Daon shushes Kandra, addressing her with a candle-based honorific, and says the matter is classified.
Someone says the single word given in ch-3-p-108, a formal address meaning Lady. The source does not tag its speaker.
Kandra gives in, says she will cheer them on, and withdraws smiling.
As Kandra turns away, a drop of candle wax falls onto the tent flap. Vesper sees it and does not ask about it. Instead he lowers his own light by one notch.
Daon closes the memo. She tells Vesper that tomorrow at 8:20 is the first real test and that she will keep talking to him through the in-ear earpiece.
Vesper replies that he will await her command.

Daon disappears toward the passageway and silence settles back over the maintenance area. Vesper stands holding his deliberately lowered light as it is, and the light trembles slightly, very slightly.
At Vesper's feet, a fire extinguisher and an ion drink whose cap has not been opened stand side by side.
Narration states that in hundreds of winters Vesper has never once learned how to become something boring.

moments.action: Vesper and Daon stand on one side of the tent canvas, her phone lit in hand; Kandra's voice arrives from beyond the canvas, balloon tail pointing to the canvas.
Kandra's ivory candle head pokes halfway through a gap in the tent, laughing at Daon's phone screen, which shows an unlettered memo list; tall Vesper stands beside Daon.
Daon shushes Kandra's candle head in the gap; Vesper addresses Kandra; Kandra, still halfway through the gap, gives in with a cheerful laugh.
Smiling, Kandra's candle head turns away out of the tent gap; a single wax drop falls onto the tent flap; Vesper's lamp head faces the drop.
Vesper's gas-lamp flame burns one notch lower and dimmer; the single wax drop rests on the tent flap nearby; Daon stands beside him.
Daon holds her phone with its screen dark and speaks up to Vesper in brisk work mode; Vesper answers, his flame still low.
Vesper stands alone in the quiet maintenance area, his low flame trembling faintly; at his feet a fire extinguisher and a sealed, label-free ion drink bottle stand side by side.

references.description: 베스퍼: 머리 대신 황동 테두리의 유리 가스등, 약 2m의 가늘고 긴 신사. 등갓 왼쪽 위에 가느다란 금 한 줄.
칸드라: 머리 대신 굵은 상아색 기둥 초, 심지 하나에 불꽃 하나. 늘씬한 숙녀.
한다온: 퍼레이드 무대 스태프. 반묶음 검은 단발, 무전기.
퍼레이드 대기 천막: 의상 행거, 분장대, 발전기.
밤 퍼레이드 길: 가상의 테마파크 광장과 조명.
직원 전용 통로(2화): 형광등이 이어진 회색 복도, 글자 없는 점검표.
퍼레이드 정비 구역(2화): 덮개 씌운 퍼레이드 차량, 장비 상자, 빈 퍼레이드 동선.
